command.description: Operation to perform. Use list_servers first, then list_tools for a server, then run_tool with the chosen tool id.

mcp_server_id.description: MCP server id returned by list_servers. Required for list_tools and run_tool.

tool_id.description: MCP tool id returned by list_tools. Required for run_tool.

args.description: JSON arguments to pass to the MCP tool when command is run_tool.
